purpose: Country-specific guide for choosing active Argentine wildlife-oriented itineraries. Focus on whale and penguin watching at Valdés and Puerto Madryn, capybaras and caimans in Iberá, Beagle Channel and Martillo observations, seasonality, optional vs included modules, and choosing between dedicated eco-tour and broad multi-region trips. Avoid duplicating the Argentina country guide and the global wildlife theme.

externalSources.supports: Peninsula Valdés: marine wildlife, southern right whales, variable months, importance of weather and season.
Official southern right whale whale-watching season and Magellanic penguin seasonal periods.
Tourism authority's July 2026 confirmation of season from June to early December, peak September–October, Puerto Pirámides and El Doradillo.
Iberá wetland fauna (capybaras, caimans, marsh deer, birds) and habitat and seasonal travel guidance.
Park-access activities and hot/cold season timing advice for observation.
Tierra del Fuego National Park wildlife, ecosystems and preferred walking season.
Beagle Channel island sailing, seabirds, sea lion colony and prevailing coastal climate.
Marine birds and penguin colonies near Isla Martillo and along Argentine Atlantic Patagonia.
